purpose: Preliminary semantic audit of the six QUDT resources used by the energy/water descriptor proposal. This does not finalize descriptor IDs, scales, or meter ranges.

method.primary_pairing_rule: Check quantity-kind qudt:applicableUnit, unit qudt:hasQuantityKind/unitForQuantityKind, and dimension vectors. Do not require reciprocal list equality; applicableUnit is materialized from hasQuantityKind and specialization relationships may explain inherited applicability.
method.reproducibility_limit: The public pages inspected report mixed rdfs:isDefinedBy versions across resources (3.5.0, 3.5.1, and 3.4.0). Therefore this is an evidence snapshot, not a reproducible audit against one pinned QUDT release. Before CI enforcement, rerun against one pinned RDF release and record the dataset checksum.

evidence.quantity_kind_page: ActiveEnergy lists KiloW-HR in applicableUnit, defines ActiveEnergy as a specialization of ElectricEnergy, and comments that applicable units are those of ElectricEnergy.
evidence.unit_page: KiloW-HR lists ElectricEnergy and Energy as hasQuantityKind and unitForQuantityKind; dimension vector is qkdv:A0E0L2I0M1H0T-2.

evidence.quantity_kind_page: Volume lists M3 in applicableUnit; dimension vector qkdv:A0E0L3I0M0H0T0D0.
evidence.unit_page: M3 lists Volume in hasQuantityKind and unitForQuantityKind; symbol m³ and UCUM code m3.

evidence.quantity_kind_page: VolumeFlowRate lists L-PER-SEC in applicableUnit; dimension vector qkdv:A0E0L3I0M0H0T-1D0.
evidence.unit_page: L-PER-SEC lists VolumeFlowRate and VolumePerTime in hasQuantityKind and unitForQuantityKind; symbol L/s and conversion multiplier 0.001.

decision.semantic_candidates: All three proposed quantity-kind/unit pairs are supported by the official resource-page evidence inspected.
not_decided: Whether m3 and L/s are the correct canonical units for target meters
Actual meter resolution and valid ranges
decision.next_required_step: Repeat this audit against one explicitly pinned QUDT RDF release (same release for quantity-kind and unit graphs), run machine checks for resource existence, applicableUnit/hasQuantityKind, dimension-vector compatibility and specialization paths, then save the release identifier and SHA-256 checksums.

pinned_release.verification_status: Checksums computed over the UTF-8 file contents retrieved from the v3.5.2 GitHub Contents API. The new CI script independently downloads the immutable commit URLs and checks these checksums before RDF parsing. CI execution has not yet been observed.
